sections.heading: Changed
items: Packaging only — no user-visible change.

sections.heading: Added
items: A banner at startup for occasional messages from us, such as a request for feedback. It is fetched once from mayorana.ch, stays until you dismiss it and is not shown again after that. If the notice cannot be fetched, no banner appears and startup is not slowed. Setting `DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK` turns it off along with the update check.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Packaging only — no user-visible change in the app. The notes for every release, with its download, are now published at [mayorana.ch/en/apps/ais-tracing/releases](https://mayorana.ch/en/apps/ais-tracing/releases).

sections.heading: Changed
items: Error handling and feedback across the scan, trace and account screens: a failure says what failed and what to do about it, instead of leaving a view empty.
Long lane names are truncated cleanly rather than pushing the timeline out of shape.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: The Windows build script handles cross-compilation correctly, and CI now blocks on clippy warnings.

sections.heading: Changed
items: CI pipeline only — no user-visible change.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: "AIS Tracing" is capitalised the same way in the window title and the in-app headers.

sections.heading: Changed
items: The update check sends a versioned User-Agent, which is what makes per-version adoption visible in the download logs — the number that says how many people are still on a build with a bug that is already fixed.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Internal: Azure sign-in consolidated into one `start_login` path shared by every screen that can trigger it.

sections.heading: Added
items: Windows support: a signed installer, the Azure CLI installed for you if it is missing, and a Start menu entry.

sections.heading: Added
items: The update check resolves the artifact for the platform it is running on, so the banner offers the macOS, Windows or Linux build directly instead of the download page.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Long lane names and field names wrap instead of overflowing their column.

sections.heading: Added
items: Scanning a Cosmos DB account reports why it failed: an expired Azure session is named as one, rather than surfacing as an account with no containers.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Release safety: the pipeline fails outright when the deploy secrets are missing, rather than reporting success for a release nobody can download.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Builds are distributed from mayorana.ch instead of GitHub Releases. Every release publishes a `latest.json` carrying the `sha256` of each artifact, so a download can be verified against a source that does not deliver it.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: The macOS binary is signed before packaging and checksummed after, so the published `sha256` matches the file you actually download.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: The app adopts the login shell's `PATH`, so `az` is found when it is launched from Finder rather than from a terminal.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: A release started from the Actions UI tags the version it prepared, instead of the branch it was dispatched from.

sections.heading: Added
items: Multi-window support: several traces open side by side, each in its own window.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: The release script no longer hangs waiting for a confirmation prompt when it runs without a terminal.

sections.heading: Added
items: A lightweight update check at startup, with a banner when a newer build is available. It reads the manifest published beside the builds, so it keeps working regardless of where the source lives.
